apofix:mana_discount.desc: Fractional discount on mana costs. 0 = no discount, 1 = free casts.
apofix:magic_resist.desc: Fractional reduction of all magic damage. 1 = full immunity.
apofix:fire_magic_resist.desc: Fractional reduction of fire magic damage. 1 = full immunity.
apofix:water_magic_resist.desc: Fractional reduction of water magic damage. 1 = full immunity.
apofix:earth_magic_resist.desc: Fractional reduction of earth magic damage. 1 = full immunity.
apofix:air_magic_resist.desc: Fractional reduction of air magic damage. 1 = full immunity.
apofix:free_cast_chance.desc: Chance that a cast costs no mana. 1 = always free.
